descriptionChirho: Feminine noun מַמְלָכוּת denoting a kingdom, reign, or royal dominion — the sphere or period of a king's rule. A variant form of מַמְלָכָה, it occurs in construct chains referring to specific kingdoms (e.g., 'kingdom of Persia' in 2 Chr 36:20,22; 'kingdom of Ahasuerus' in Est 1:2,14,20, 2:3,16,17; Dan 8:1, 11:17,21). Multilingual evidence shows semantic unity: eng kingdom/reign, spa reino/reinado, hin राज्य, arb مَمْلَكَة, kor 왕국, swa ufalme. The single 'reign-of' occurrence differs only in English nuance, not in Hebrew semantics.
